rules.name: recon-snapshot-columns-02-views-one-bu
rules.sql: SELECT p.business_unit, max(p.settlement_date) AS settlement_date FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' GROUP BY p.business_unit

SELECT count(*) AS view_rows, count(DISTINCT v.trade_id) AS trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.source_trade_id IS NULL) AS source_trade_id_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.nc_factor IS NULL) AS nc_factor_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.fx_nc_factor IS NULL) AS fx_nc_factor_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.mtm_usd IS NULL) AS mtm_usd_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.mtm_usd IS NULL AND v.mtm_nc IS NOT NULL AND v.nc_factor IS NOT NULL AND v.fx_nc_factor IS NOT NULL) AS mtm_usd_null_with_factors, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.mtm_usd IS NOT NULL AND v.mtm_nc IS NOT NULL AND v.nc_factor IS NOT NULL AND v.fx_nc_factor IS NOT NULL AND abs(v.mtm_usd - v.mtm_nc * v.nc_factor * v.fx_nc_factor) > 0.01 + 0.000000001 * abs(v.mtm_usd)) AS mtm_usd_not_equal_product FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu AND v.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING')

SELECT count(*) AS eod_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.deal_status IS NULL) AS deal_status_missing, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.acc_group IS NULL) AS netting_group_missing FROM opera.helper_eod_monthend_report_view e WHERE e.tenant_id = :tenant AND e.business_unit = :bu AND e.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING')

SELECT count(*) AS risk_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AS premium_paid_missing FROM opera.helper_risk_office_otc_report_new r WHERE r.tenant_id = :tenant AND r.business_unit = :bu AND r.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING')

expect.reason: the BU has a published settle snapshot
the consumer view returns rows for the BU
the view exposes source_trade_id on every row (the BU is refreshed with the v4 builder)
mtm_usd is never NULL when mtm_nc, nc_factor and fx_nc_factor are present
mtm_usd equals mtm_nc times nc_factor times fx_nc_factor on every row
